segments.he: עִקַּר הַחִנּוּךְ לַעֲבוֹדַת ה' הוּא עַל יְדֵי הִתְבּוֹדְדוּת
segments.en: When a Yisraelite enters to pray his prayer and his sicha before Hashem blessed be He — to merit drawing close to Him and fulfilling His Torah and commandments — and he wishes to make from Torah a prayer, but as yet has no words upon his tongue to speak; because he still does not know the ways and signposts of the Torah, and does not know how to pray and speak and converse — then the aspect of Rachel, which is the aspect of Torah She'b'al Peh, the aspect of Torah innovations from which flow the pathways to make prayers from Torah teachings, as described above — she herself has mercy upon this Yisraelite who is praying, he who is in the aspect of Leah, as explained above. And she transmits to him the signposts and the pathways of the Torah, and herself speaks with her beloved — the aspect of Yaakov, the aspect of the general root of Torah — so that he may make from Torah a prayer, so that Torah and prayer may be joined together, so that they may bring forth good deeds.

segments.he: עִקַּר הַחִנּוּךְ שֶׁל כָּל אָדָם בַּעֲבוֹדַת ה' הוּא עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינָה הַנַּ"ל בַּמַּאֲמָר הַנַּ"ל. (תּוֹרָה ל"ד) הַיְנוּ עַל יְדֵי אוֹר הַנְּקֻדָּה הַנַּ"ל. דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁמְּקַבֵּל מֵאוֹר הַנְּקֻדָּה שֶׁל הַצַּדִּיק. וְאַחַר כָּךְ מְקַבֵּל כָּל אֶחָד מֵחֲבֵרוֹ וְכוּ' כַּנַּ"ל. וְאַחַר כָּךְ מִנֵּהּ וּבֵהּ עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמְּדַבֵּר בֵּינוֹ לְבֵין קוֹנוֹ וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה מֵאִיר הַנְּקֻדָּה. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה מְקַשֵּׁר אֶת הַלֵּב לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ וְנִתְבַּטְּלִין כָּל הַחֲרָפוֹת וְהַשְּׁבִירוֹת דְּהַיְנוּ אַהֲבוֹת רָעוֹת וְכוּ'. וְעוֹלֶה מֵחֹל לְקדֶשׁ. נִמְצָא שֶׁעִקַּר הַחִנּוּךְ לִכְנס אֶל הַקְּדֻשָּׁה הוּא עַל יְדֵי הַנְּקֻדָּה הַנַּ"ל הַיְנוּ עַל יְדֵי הִתְבּוֹדְדוּת וְשִׂיחָה בֵּינוֹ לְבֵין קוֹנוֹ שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה דַּיְקָא מְאִירָה הַנְּקֻדָּה כַּנַּ"ל. (הִלְכוֹת בִּרְכַּת הַמָּזוֹן הֲלָכָה ג אוֹת יג):
segments.en: This is the aspect of the words that flow to a person when he enters into hisbodidus to pour out his speech before Hashem blessed be He: at first he knows no words to speak, but when he is strong in his resolve and forces himself to speak nonetheless — then most often words come to him that he had never imagined he would say. And these words are sent to him from Heaven, drawn from the aspect described above.
